# FO - Product with 0 quantity show us a date with : 0000-00-00

When I create a new product with 0 quantity, If I go to the FO and check this one, we'll have a Available date : 0000-00-00 as you can see : 

![image](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/assets/100699445/be69b81f-2a54-4ac2-8eef-9bc9a2441cec)

## Attendu
We expected that if we don't put a date, the available date shouldn't be show, and if there is no product detail, this tab shouldn't be show.

## Étapes
1. Go to BO 
2. Go to Catalog > Products
3. Clic on New Product 
4. Clic on Standard Product 
5. Clic on Add new Product 
6. Set a title 
7. Put it Online 
8. Save it 
9. Go to FO 
10. Check you product 
11. :negative_squared_cross_mark: You'll have the available date with many 0
